tasks.desc: Derive the structural formula and select the two-heap prefix/suffix approach
Implement the full Python solution: two-heap `even_prefix_scores` returning even-prefix values, even N full value, odd N max over `pref[t] + suff[m-t]`; samples and small brute force pass
Ensure the final submitted code is clean, O(N log N) time, O(N) memory, reads stdin/writes stdout, and is enclosed in the required code delimiters

proposals: Implement the two-heap prefix/suffix order-statistic approach first, since it matches the structural formula and is O(N log N).
Use a Fenwick tree over compressed values as an alternative if maintaining two heaps for both prefixes and suffixes is too error-prone.
Build a small brute-force checker for tiny N to validate the even-block formula and odd-split rule, and to test edge cases.
Investigate the greedy adjacent-maximum heuristic only as a sanity check, and use the known counterexample to confirm it is not final.
If correctness proof is needed, develop the uncrossing/exchange argument and the sign-cancellation achievability argument before coding.
